title: ENC-686: EngineHost FIFO ordering for buffered control/data
body:
Fixes a command-ordering bug where a directly-applied control command could jump ahead of still-buffered commands (e.g. runtime setTransform before the buffered scene-init createTransform → 'transform not found'). Buffer when controls are pending; data waits behind pending control/data so it lands after its buffers are created.
